regime_context: The Canada/TSX detector shows a broad two-theme precious-metals leadership structure (Silver & Royalties leading Gold Miners by a thin margin) with only 9 of 16 themes trending above their absolute-trend gate, and a mostly coincident macro backdrop dominated by AI/geopolitics headlines with very high unscheduled-surprise share. Gate discipline is validated on this market's history (trend-following helps control drawdown), but the track record's directional accuracy is weak at 0.306, so convictions must stay low and conditionals humble.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Gold Miners (rank 2, durability 0.75) overtakes Silver & Royalties (rank 1, durability 0.7) as the confirmed leader — a leader-challenger flip where Gold Miners' score exceeds Silver & Royalties' score for 5 consecutive sessions would retire this watch and re-order the precious-metals complex read.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: The top-ranked theme is eligible above its absolute-trend gate with full breadth (1.0) and a moderate durability bar of 0.7, supported by a trend-friendly (mixed, not mean-reverting) Hurst tag and no crowding flag. This is a stay-with-the-leader read, not a return forecast: the trend gate is the one validated leg, and Silver & Royalties sits comfortably above it.
theses.dissent: Silver & Royalties and Gold Miners share the same proxy (XGD.TO) and a 0.137 leader-challenger margin, so the 'lead' may be an artifact of one high-beta precious-metals complex rather than a distinct, durable leadership; the one-narrative flag is false and absorption is low at 0.31.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO breaks back below its own 50-day trend (or Silver & Royalties rank slips below rank 3) before the 20-trading-day check-by date without reclaiming eligibility

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Rank 2, eligible, full breadth, highest durability bar in the table (0.75), and not crowded. This is the challenger one step behind the leader with stronger trend-health; as a trend-following posture it warrants the same directional lean, not a relative bet against the leader.
theses.dissent: Gold Miners and Silver & Royalties proxy to the same ETF (XGD.TO), so an overweight on both is effectively a single precious-metals-complex call; if silver-specific strength fades while gold holds, the leader/challenger distinction collapses and both read as one trade.

falsifier.text: Gold Miners drops below its absolute-trend gate (rank score turns ineligible) before the 20-trading-day check-by date

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Eligible and rank 3, but crowded (crowding_z 1.23, crowded=true) with a lower durability bar (0.67) than the two precious-metals leaders above it. Crowding is a size-down caution, so while the absolute-trend gate still permits participation, the crowding texture argues for avoiding fresh initiation here relative to cleaner full-breadth leaders.
evidence: durability_bar 0.67 lower than Silver & Royalties (0.7) and Gold (0.75)
theses.dissent: The trend gate is validated and Base Metals remains eligible above it with full breadth; a crowded flag is a caution, not a reason to be underweight a still-trending theme, and raw-materials strength often runs longer than crowding measures suggest.

falsifier.text: Base Metals & Copper relaxes its crowding flag (crowded flips to false) while staying eligible and its durability bar rises above 0.7 before the 20-trading-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
